card.name: Postmarketing reports of adverse events
card.fires_on: Words in the phrase that introduces where a side effect was reported, such as 'postmarketing experience', 'post market use', 'reported in clinical studies' or 'have frequently presented'. It fires on the word right after the postmarketing or reporting cue.

modes.label: After postmarketing
modes.description: The word or comma that follows 'postmarketing' or 'post market' in a safety statement.
modes.example: Respiratory depression has been observed in postmarketing<< experience>> [see Warnings and Precautions

modes.label: Reported-in verbs and settings
modes.description: The verb or setting word in 'has been reported' or 'in clinical studies' sentences about adverse events.
modes.example: Gastrointestinal perforations have been reported in clinical<< studies>> with OLUMIANT.

card.writes: It suppresses 'recent' and similar words, so it seems to steer away from describing the evidence as recent.
card.plain: It marks the wording that says a side effect was seen in postmarketing use or in studies.
